neighbours.label: The token ' Joy' (name, band, brand or the noun 'joy'), vs other given names and near spellings (Joan, Jay, Jody)
fire: Last night my sister Joy cooked dinner for the whole street.
The first song on the record was written by Joy Harper.
Our new neighbour, a nurse named Joy, waved from her porch.
The children read a picture book about a puppy called Joy.
At the reunion, everyone wanted to talk to Joy about her trip.
The shop on the corner sells Joy brand candles and soap.
My grandmother Joy still bakes bread every Sunday morning.
In the second act, Joy finally tells her brother the truth.
quiet: Last night my sister Joan cooked dinner for the whole street.
The first song on the record was written by Jay Harper.
Our new neighbour, a nurse named Grace, waved from her porch.
The children read a picture book about a puppy called Biscuit.
At the reunion, everyone wanted to talk to Jody about her trip.
The shop on the corner sells Hope brand candles and soap.
My grandmother Ruth still bakes bread every Sunday morning.
In the second act, Clara finally tells her brother the truth.

notes: Card: ' Joy' x22, 'joy' x3, 'oy' in split Joy|ce names. Probe: 'Joy Division' 0.837, 'Joycean' (' Joy' + 'cean') 0.884, 'my aunt Joy' 0.746, lowercase 'pure joy' 0.593; 'Joyce' (single token) 0.335, 'Joey' 0.114, 'aunt Ruth' 0.010, 'enjoy' 0.007. Near misses use names that do not start with the Joy token (Joan, Jay, Grace, Hope; Jody splits J|ody). Joyce avoided because it leaked 0.335.
